headline: Law extends the Federal Election Commission's program for fining late or missing campaign finance reports through 2033.
what_it_does: This law extends the Federal Election Commission's Administrative Fine Program through December 31, 2033. The program lets the commission use a faster process to enforce rules when campaign finance disclosure reports are filed late or not filed at all.

who_it_affects.group: Political candidates' campaign committees, political parties, and PACs that must file reports with the Federal Election Commission
who_it_affects.how: They can continue to face fines through a faster enforcement process if they file required disclosure reports late or not at all.
The commission keeps its legal authority to run the expedited fine program for another decade.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 19, 2023; extends the program through December 31, 2033.
